approval_reference: 사용자 최신 지시: 권장안대로 진행하고 이후 작업순서에 따라 블루프린트(와이어프레임, 플로우 맵 등) 작업을 시작하고, 벤치마킹과 필요한 이미지/UI 제작을 진행한다.

context_configuration_hygiene.scope: L1 blueprint, plan, benchmark, contract test, and one environment-only candidate. No runtime Scene, GDScript, card rule, save, Base, or legacy-save mutation.

inventory.references_and_consumers: project.godot entry and Story Front Door tests
no runtime consumer; rejected because architectural marks could be mistaken for live state
planned-only until user final visual lock
user-owned preserved legacy save; no writes

actual_project_evidence: project.godot runs StoryFrontDoor as the current main scene.
StoryFrontDoor -> AdmissionPrologue -> StoryEventRoot is editor-observed and deterministic-test covered.
CircleComposition, EventClockState/Resolver/View, direct glyph writing, and story-owned CardArchiveScreen exist in the exact worktree.
FirstClassRoot, DuelPracticumRoot, FestivalCanopyRoot, and a chapter route definition do not yet exist.
implementation_feasibility_recheck.limit: The blueprint is implementable through existing seams, but future scenes, target-resolution runtime renders, and all human/device/accessibility/performance/export evidence are not yet executed.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: A new blueprint could turn the front door back into an activity hub.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Flow begins only from StoryFrontDoor and preserves no activity-mode buttons.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: The greenhouse can be misread as the entire product.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Class, duel, and festival are explicit sequential beats and their separate visual consumers are named.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: Card inspiration could silently manufacture the user-deferred rules.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Every card path retains RULESET_PENDING and no independent duel route.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: A generated background could appear final or contain functional state.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Manifest fixes GENERATED_CANDIDATE, no baked text/glyph/character, false runtime_bound, and USER_FINAL_LOCK_REQUIRED.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: Documents could overclaim actual playable coverage or human proof.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Current/plan/candidate states are separated and evidence ceiling remains planning/candidate only.
